listing.name: Vertical Bar Agent
listing.description: Inspect authorized NetSuite snapshots and process data, publish grounded Briefings, manage Test Suites and governed release workflows, and author Stress Test contracts. Start Stress Tests asynchronously, follow live CrossCheck Run links, read progress and bounded reports, and request graceful cancellation. Execution can create real NetSuite records; smoke runs also write records and do not clean them up automatically. Agent execution is restricted to verified active sandbox or release_preview environments. Production and development execution is available only in the CrossCheck product UI; MCP runtime guards cover Stress Tests, Test Suites and every CI workflow stage.

remoteConnector.testPolicy: Use a populated dedicated non-customer reviewer account. Record successful live tool exercises and authorization refusals truthfully; fixture checks alone are not live dogfood.
remoteConnector.executionBoundary: Hosted Node and installed Rust MCP runtimes resolve fresh authorized environment metadata on every start and reject production, development, inactive, unknown or unverified targets before dispatch. Stress Test and Test Suite starts check the selected environment; CI workflow starts check every stage. Skills also refuse delegated, direct API or browser-click workarounds. Users execute production runs themselves in the CrossCheck product UI. Authoring, preview, publishing, observation and explicitly requested Stress Run cancellation remain available.
